youtube_title: Snoring Like A Tractor? Try This First | Body Fix #45 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #45. Your roommate says you were driving a TRACTOR last night? Snoring?
B is right. Sleep on your SIDE. On your back, the tongue and throat fall back.
Back sleeping, blocked nose, smoking, extra weight: all make it worse.
Fix: Side sleeping, clear nose, no smoking, healthy weight.
Red flags: Breathing stops, choking in sleep, or sleepy all day? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Snoring
